title: Why We Switched to a Slower Roast Curve
excerpt: A longer roast changed how our single-origins actually taste — here's what we learned.
content:
Last spring we slowed our roast curve down by almost two minutes across the board. It cost us throughput, but the difference in the cup — more clarity in the acidity, less of that flat "roasted" flavor masking the origin — was worth it immediately.

If you've had our Ethiopia Guji before and after, you'll notice it now: less smoke, more stone fruit.

title: Meet Our Newest Farm Partner
excerpt: We've added a third direct-trade relationship this year, from the Huila region of Colombia.
content:
We're excited to welcome a new farm partner to the lineup this year, a family-run operation in Huila, Colombia. We visited in March, cupped a dozen lots, and brought home three.

Look for the first bags on shelves next month.
